select
  geolocation_zip_code_prefix as zip_code_prefix,
  avg(geolocation_lat) as latitude,
  avg(geolocation_lng) as longitude
from raw.geolocation
group by 1

select
  i.order_id,
  count(*) as item_count,
  count(distinct i.seller_id) as seller_count,
  sum(i.price) as price,
  sum(i.freight_value) as freight_value,
  min(i.seller_id) as primary_seller_id,
  min(s.seller_state) as seller_state,
  min(s.seller_zip_code_prefix) as seller_zip_code_prefix,
  min(coalesce(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name, 'unknown')) as product_category_name_english
from raw.order_items i
left join raw.sellers s using (seller_id)
left join raw.products p using (product_id)
left join raw.category_translation t using (product_category_name)
group by 1

with reviews as (
  select order_id, avg(review_score) as review_score
  from raw.order_reviews group by 1
), payments as (
  select order_id, sum(payment_value) as payment_value
  from raw.order_payments group by 1
)
select
  o.order_id,
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_unique_id,
  c.customer_state,
  c.customer_zip_code_prefix,
  i.primary_seller_id,
  i.seller_state,
  i.seller_zip_code_prefix,
  i.product_category_name_english,
  cast(o.order_purchase_timestamp as timestamp) as order_purchase_timestamp,
  cast(o.order_approved_at as timestamp) as order_approved_at,
  cast(o.order_delivered_customer_date as timestamp) as order_delivered_customer_date,
  cast(o.order_estimated_delivery_date as timestamp) as order_estimated_delivery_date,
  o.order_status,
  i.item_count,
  i.seller_count,
  i.price,
  i.freight_value,
  p.payment_value,
  r.review_score
from raw.orders o
join raw.customers c using (customer_id)
left join "recoveriq"."analytics"."stg_order_items" i using (order_id)
left join payments p using (order_id)
left join reviews r using (order_id)

with all_values as (

    select
        order_status as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "recoveriq"."analytics"."fact_orders"
    group by order_status

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'approved','canceled','created','delivered','invoiced','processing','shipped','unavailable'
)

select customer_unique_id
from "recoveriq"."analytics"."fact_orders"
where customer_unique_id is null

select order_id
from "recoveriq"."analytics"."fact_orders"
where order_id is null

select
    order_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "recoveriq"."analytics"."fact_orders"
where order_id is not null
group by order_id
having count(*) > 1

with base as (
  select
    o.*,
    case when o.order_status = 'delivered'
      and cast(o.order_delivered_customer_date as date) > cast(o.order_estimated_delivery_date as date)
      then 1 else 0 end as observed_late
  from "recoveriq"."analytics"."fact_orders" o
), seller_history as (
  select
    *,
    count(*) over (
      partition by primary_seller_id order by order_purchase_timestamp, order_id
      rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding
    ) as seller_prior_orders,
    avg(observed_late) over (
      partition by primary_seller_id order by order_purchase_timestamp, order_id
      rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding
    ) as seller_prior_late_rate
  from base
), enriched as (
  select
    h.*,
    cg.latitude as customer_lat,
    cg.longitude as customer_lng,
    sg.latitude as seller_lat,
    sg.longitude as seller_lng
  from seller_history h
  left join "recoveriq"."analytics"."stg_geo" cg on h.customer_zip_code_prefix = cg.zip_code_prefix
  left join "recoveriq"."analytics"."stg_geo" sg on h.seller_zip_code_prefix = sg.zip_code_prefix
)
select
  order_id,
  order_purchase_timestamp,
  price,
  freight_value,
  item_count,
  seller_count,
  date_diff('day', order_approved_at, order_estimated_delivery_date) as estimated_delivery_days,
  case when customer_lat is null or seller_lat is null then null else
    6371 * 2 * asin(sqrt(
      pow(sin(radians(customer_lat - seller_lat) / 2), 2) +
      cos(radians(seller_lat)) * cos(radians(customer_lat)) *
      pow(sin(radians(customer_lng - seller_lng) / 2), 2)
    )) end as customer_seller_distance_km,
  seller_prior_orders,
  coalesce(seller_prior_late_rate, 0.0) as seller_prior_late_rate,
  extract(hour from order_purchase_timestamp) as purchase_hour,
  extract(dow from order_purchase_timestamp) as purchase_day_of_week,
  extract(month from order_purchase_timestamp) as purchase_month,
  coalesce(customer_state, 'unknown') as customer_state,
  coalesce(seller_state, 'unknown') as seller_state,
  coalesce(product_category_name_english, 'unknown') as product_category_name_english
from enriched
where order_approved_at is not null

with bounds as (
  select max(order_purchase_timestamp) as observation_end from "recoveriq"."analytics"."fact_orders"
)
select
  o.order_id,
  case when o.order_status = 'delivered'
    and cast(o.order_delivered_customer_date as date) > cast(o.order_estimated_delivery_date as date)
    then 1 else 0 end as late_delivery,
  case when o.review_score <= 2 then 1 else 0 end as low_review,
  case when exists (
    select 1 from "recoveriq"."analytics"."fact_orders" future
    where future.customer_unique_id = o.customer_unique_id
      and future.order_purchase_timestamp > o.order_delivered_customer_date
      and future.order_purchase_timestamp <= o.order_delivered_customer_date + interval 90 day
  ) then 1 else 0 end as repeat_purchase_90d,
  case when o.order_delivered_customer_date <= b.observation_end - interval 90 day then 1 else 0 end as repeat_observed_90d
from "recoveriq"."analytics"."fact_orders" o
cross join bounds b

select order_id
from "recoveriq"."analytics"."order_features"
where order_id is null

select order_purchase_timestamp
from "recoveriq"."analytics"."order_features"
where order_purchase_timestamp is null

select
    order_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "recoveriq"."analytics"."order_features"
where order_id is not null
group by order_id
having count(*) > 1

with all_values as (

    select
        late_delivery as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "recoveriq"."analytics"."order_outcomes"
    group by late_delivery

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    '0','1'
)

with all_values as (

    select
        repeat_purchase_90d as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from "recoveriq"."analytics"."order_outcomes"
    group by repeat_purchase_90d

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    '0','1'
)

select order_id
from "recoveriq"."analytics"."order_outcomes"
where order_id is null

with child as (
    select order_id as from_field
    from "recoveriq"."analytics"."order_outcomes"
    where order_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select order_id as to_field
    from "recoveriq"."analytics"."fact_orders"
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

select
    order_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from "recoveriq"."analytics"."order_outcomes"
where order_id is not null
group by order_id
having count(*) > 1
